name: io.github.cheshirecode/worklog-memory-mcp
title: Worklog Memory
description: Agent memory over a git worklog vault: FSM task files with typed evidence, not embeddings soup.

environmentVariables.name: WORKLOG_REPO
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the worklog vault clone this server reads and writes.

environmentVariables.name: WORKLOG_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the worklog skill's bin/ directory. Every write runs these scripts, so vault lint and commit hooks apply.

environmentVariables.name: WORKLOG_LDAP
environmentVariables.description: Namespace under people/ in the vault. Defaults to 'oss'.
